document.title: Infrastructure Health Report — 2026-03-19
document.content:
# Infrastructure Health Report — 2026-03-19

## Summary
Overall system is operational, but multiple services are in an unhealthy or stopped state. Immediate attention required for Omiximo and Lidaros components.

## PM2 Status
- **Total Services:** 15
- **Stopped:** 1 (whisper)
- **Issues:** `whisper` has 518 restarts and is currently stopped. High restart counts on `stella-tax` (63) and `kira-app` (46).

## Docker Status
- **Unhealthy:** 2
  - `lidaros-frontend-1` (unhealthy)
  - `omiximo-email-automation` (unhealthy)
- **Healthy:** Most core services (Postgres, Redis, Neo4j, n8n, Ollama) are Up and Healthy.

## System Resources
- **Disk:** 69% used (457G/662G). Well within safe limits (<85%).
- **Memory:** 42% used (11.5GB/27.5GB). Sufficient headroom.
- **GPU:** RTX 4090 at 43°C. Memory usage at 83% (20.5GB/24.5GB) due to `VLLM::EngineCore`. Utilization is 0%.

## OpenClaw Gateway
- **Status:** Running (PID 198071)
- **Warnings:** Multiple 'Doctor' warnings regarding `groupPolicy: allowlist` without allowed IDs. This will cause group messages to be dropped.

## Actions Taken
- Generated high-severity alert for unhealthy services.
- Monitoring disk and memory (no action needed).
